# hampiway-catalogo26
Catálogo hampiway 26

<title>Hampiway — Catálogo 2026 | Cosmética Orgánica Andina</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,600;1,300;1,400&family=Jost:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --v:#2D5016;--d:#8B6914;--a:#C4A882;--f:#FAF7F2;
  --o:#1A2B0F;--t:#2C2416;
  --agu:#1B6B8A;--air:#7A9B5E;--tie:#6B4423;--fue:#C44B2B;
  --ln:rgba(139,105,20,.18);--r:3px;
}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{background:var(--f);color:var(--t);font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-weight:300;overflow-x:hidden}

nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:900;background:rgba(250,247,242,.97);
backdrop-filter:blur(12px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
border-bottom:1px solid var(–ln);height:56px;display:flex;
align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 1.8rem}
.nav-logo img{height:38px;object-fit:contain;display:block}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:0;list-style:none}
.nav-links a{font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;
color:var(–t);padding:.4rem .65rem;transition:color .2s;font-weight:400}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(–d)}
.nav-links a.agu{color:var(–agu)}.nav-links a.air{color:var(–air)}
.nav-links a.tie{color:var(–tie)}.nav-links a.fue{color:var(–fue)}
.nav-links a.active{font-weight:600}

.pg{min-height:100vh;padding-top:56px}
.pi-wrap{max-width:980px;margin:0 auto;padding:3rem 2rem}
.lbl{font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(–d);font-weight:500;margin-bottom:.4rem}
.divh{width:100%;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(–d),transparent);opacity:.3;margin:2rem 0}
.divs{width:48px;height:1px;background:var(–d);opacity:.6;margin:.8rem 0}

/* PORTADA */
#portada{background:var(–o);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;
justify-content:center;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
padding-top:0;min-height:100vh}
#portada::before{content:’’;position:absolute;inset:0;
background:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 65% at 50% 42%,rgba(45,80,22,.38) 0%,transparent 70%);
pointer-events:none}
.portada-inner{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:2rem}
.portada-eyebrow{font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.32em;text-transform:uppercase;
color:var(–a);margin-bottom:1.6rem;font-weight:400}
.portada-logo-wrap{background:rgba(250,247,242,.09);border:1px solid rgba(196,168,130,.18);
border-radius:var(–r);padding:.9rem 1.8rem;display:inline-block;margin-bottom:.8rem}
.portada-logo-wrap img{height:108px;object-fit:contain;display:block}
.portada-tagline{font-family:‘Cormorant Garamond’,serif;font-size:clamp(1rem,2.8vw,1.4rem);
font-weight:300;font-style:italic;color:var(–a);letter-spacing:.07em}
.portada-sub{font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;
color:rgba(250,247,242,.3);margin-top:2rem}
.portada-corner{position:absolute;width:26px;height:26px;border-color:rgba(139,105,20,.22);border-style:solid}
.portada-corner.tl{top:16px;left:16px;border-width:1px 0 0 1px}
.portada-corner.tr{top:16px;right:16px;border-width:1px 1px 0 0}
.portada-corner.bl{bottom:16px;left:16px;border-width:0 0 1px 1px}
.portada-corner.br{bottom:16px;right:16px;border-width:0 1px 1px 0}
.portada-foot{position:absolute;bottom:1.6rem;font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.18em;
text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(250,247,242,.18)}
.portada-foot.l{left:1.6rem}.portada-foot.r{right:1.6rem}

/* MANIFIESTO */
#manifiesto{background:var(–f)}
.manif-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:3.5rem;align-items:start}
.manif-text h2{font-family:‘Cormorant Garamond’,serif;font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,3rem);
font-weight:400;line-height:1.15;color:var(–v);margin-bottom:1.2rem}
.manif-text p{font-size:.85rem;line-height:1.9;opacity:.8;margin-bottom:.9rem}
.manif-quote{font-family:‘Cormorant Garamond’,serif;font-size:1rem;font-style:italic;
color:var(–d);line-height:1.7;border-left:2px solid var(–d);padding-left:1rem;margin:1.2rem 0;opacity:.85}
.manif-img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/4;background:linear-gradient(155deg,var(–v),var(–o));
border-radius:var(–r);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;
padding-bottom:1rem;color:rgba(250,247,242,.25);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
.sellos{display:flex;gap:.6rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:1.5rem}
.sello{font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(–d);
font-weight:500;border:1px solid rgba(139,105,20,.28);padding:.35rem .75rem;border-radius:2px}

/* LÍNEAS */
#lineas{background:var(–f)}
.lineas-header{text-align:center;margin-bottom:2.5rem}
.lineas-header h2{font-family:‘Cormorant Garamond’,serif;font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4vw,2.8rem);
font-weight:400;color:var(–v)}
.lineas-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2px;background:var(–ln)}
.lc{background:var(–f);padding:2.2rem 2rem;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;display:block;transition:background .25s}
.lc:hover{background:#fff}
.lc::before{content:’’;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:3px;height:100%}
.lc.agu::before{background:var(–agu)}.lc.air::before{background:var(–air)}
.lc.tie::before{background:var(–tie)}.lc.fue::before{background:var(–fue)}
.lc-icon{height:48px;object-fit:contain;display:block;margin-bottom:.8rem}
.lc-name{font-family:‘Cormorant Garamond’,serif;font-size:1.55rem;font-weight:500;margin-bottom:.2rem}
.lc.agu .lc-name{color:var(–agu)}.lc.air .lc-name{color:var(–air)}
.lc.tie .lc-name{color:var(–tie)}.lc.fue .lc-name{color:var(–fue)}
.lc-el{font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(–d);margin-bottom:.75rem;font-weight:500}
.lc-desc{font-size:.82rem;line-height:1.7;opacity:.65;margin-bottom:1rem}
.lc-cnt{font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.38}
.lc-num{position:absolute;bottom:-.5rem;right:.8rem;font-family:‘Cormorant Garamond’,serif;
font-size:6.5rem;font-weight:300;opacity:.035;line-height:1;color:var(–t);pointer-events:none}

/* PRODUCTOS */
.prod-pg{background:var(–f)}
.sec-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;
margin-bottom:2rem;padding-bottom:1.2rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(–ln)}
.sec-title{font-family:‘Cormorant Garamond’,serif;font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4vw,2.5rem);
font-weight:400;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;line-height:1}
.sec-icon{height:32px;object-fit:contain}
.sec-elem{font-size:.72rem;opacity:.45;margin-top:.3rem;letter-spacing:.06em}
.sec-head-r{font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.35;padding-bottom:.2rem}
.pgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2px;background:var(–ln)}
.pc{background:#fff;padding:1.4rem;display:flex;gap:1.1rem;transition:background .2s}
.pc:hover{background:rgba(45,80,22,.025)}
.pc-img{width:88px;min-width:88px;height:112px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:2px;flex-shrink:0}
.pd{flex:1;min-width:0}
.pt{font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:.3rem}
.agu-t{color:var(–agu)}.air-t{color:var(–air)}.tie-t{color:var(–tie)}.fue-t{color:var(–fue)}
.pn{font-family:‘Cormorant Garamond’,serif;font-size:1.08rem;font-weight:500;
line-height:1.2;color:var(–t);margin-bottom:.35rem}
.pdesc{font-size:.74rem;line-height:1.65;opacity:.62;margin-bottom:.6rem}
.pm{display:flex;gap:.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-bottom:.4rem}
.fmt{font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.45}
.precio{font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;color:var(–d)}
.tienda{font-size:.6rem;opacity:.38;letter-spacing:.05em}
.uso{font-size:.78rem;opacity:.4;margin-bottom:.4rem}
.mix-hdr{grid-column:1/-1;padding:1.2rem 1.4rem .4rem;font-family:‘Cormorant Garamond’,serif;
font-size:1rem;font-style:italic;color:var(–d);background:#fff;border-top:1px solid var(–ln)}

/* WHATSAPP */
.wa-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;background:#25D366;
color:#fff!important;text-decoration:none;font-size:.58rem;font-weight:600;
letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:3px;
transition:background .2s,transform .15s}
.wa-btn:hover{background:#1da851;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.wa-btn svg{width:11px;height:11px;fill:#fff;flex-shrink:0}
#wa-float{position:fixed;bottom:26px;right:26px;z-index:9999;background:#25D366;
width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;
justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(37,211,102,.4);
transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s;text-decoration:none}
#wa-float:hover{transform:scale(1.1);box-shadow:0 6px 28px rgba(37,211,102,.55)}
#wa-float svg{width:30px;height:30px;fill:#fff}
#wa-pulse{position:fixed;bottom:26px;right:26px;z-index:9998;width:56px;height:56px;
border-radius:50%;background:#25D366;opacity:0;animation:wapulse 2.5s ease-out infinite}
@keyframes wapulse{0%{transform:scale(1);opacity:.6}100%{transform:scale(2);opacity:0}}

/* INGREDIENTES */
#ingredientes{background:var(–o);color:var(–f)}
.ing-header h2{font-family:‘Cormorant Garamond’,serif;font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4vw,2.8rem);font-weight:400;color:var(–a)}
.ing-header p{font-size:.78rem;opacity:.4;letter-spacing:.08em;margin-top:.3rem}
.ing-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:1px;background:rgba(139,105,20,.15);margin-top:2rem}
.ing-cell{background:var(–o);padding:1.3rem .8rem;text-align:center;transition:background .2s}
.ing-cell:hover{background:rgba(45,80,22,.5)}
.ing-icon{font-size:1.5rem;display:block;margin-bottom:.4rem}
.ing-name{font-family:‘Cormorant Garamond’,serif;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:500;color:var(–a);margin-bottom:.2rem}
.ing-prop{font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.35;line-height:1.5}

/* CERTS */
#certs{background:var(–f)}
.certs-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1.2rem;margin-top:2rem}
.cert-card{border:1px solid var(–ln);padding:1.8rem 1.2rem;text-align:center;
border-radius:var(–r);transition:border-color .2s,transform .2s}
.cert-card:hover{border-color:var(–d);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.cert-icon{font-size:1.7rem;display:block;margin-bottom:.7rem}
.cert-title{font-family:‘Cormorant Garamond’,serif;font-size:1rem;font-weight:500;color:var(–v);margin-bottom:.4rem}
.cert-desc{font-size:.72rem;line-height:1.65;opacity:.6}
.cert-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;margin-top:1.8rem;justify-content:center}
.cert-tag{font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.35rem .8rem;
border:1px solid rgba(45,80,22,.2);color:var(–v);font-weight:500;border-radius:2px}

/* CONTACTO */
#contacto{background:var(–f)}
.contacto-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:3.5rem;align-items:start}
.contacto-grid h2{font-family:‘Cormorant Garamond’,serif;font-size:clamp(1.6rem,3.5vw,2.4rem);
font-weight:400;color:var(–v);margin-bottom:1.8rem;line-height:1.2}
.canal{display:flex;gap:.9rem;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:1.2rem;
padding-bottom:1.2rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(–ln)}
.canal:last-child{border:none}
.canal-ico{font-size:1.1rem;margin-top:.1rem;flex-shrink:0}
.canal-tipo{font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(–d);font-weight:500;margin-bottom:.15rem}
.canal-info{font-size:.8rem;opacity:.7;line-height:1.6}
.mapa-box{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1;background:linear-gradient(155deg,rgba(45,80,22,.07),rgba(45,80,22,.16));
border:1px solid var(–ln);border-radius:var(–r);display:flex;flex-direction:column;
align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.4rem;position:relative}
.mapa-box::before{content:’’;position:absolute;width:74%;height:74%;
border:1px dashed rgba(139,105,20,.15);border-radius:50%}
.mapa-pin{font-size:1.8rem}
.mapa-name{font-family:‘Cormorant Garamond’,serif;font-size:.95rem;font-style:italic;color:var(–v)}
.mapa-sub{font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.35}
.qr-box{margin-top:1.5rem;text-align:center}
.qr-box img{width:112px;height:112px;object-fit:contain;display:block;margin:0 auto;
border:1px solid var(–ln);padding:6px;background:#fff;border-radius:var(–r)}
.qr-box p{font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.35;margin-top:.45rem;line-height:1.6}

/* CONTRAPORTADA */
#contra{background:var(–o);min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding-top:56px}
#contra::before{content:’’;position:absolute;inset:0;
background:radial-gradient(ellipse 65% 65% at 50% 50%,rgba(139,105,20,.07) 0%,transparent 70%);pointer-events:none}
.contra-inner{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:2rem}
.contra-logo-wrap{background:rgba(250,247,242,.09);border:1px solid rgba(196,168,130,.15);
border-radius:var(–r);padding:.8rem 1.6rem;display:inline-block}
.contra-logo-wrap img{height:86px;object-fit:contain;display:block}
.contra-tagline{font-family:‘Cormorant Garamond’,serif;font-size:1.1rem;font-style:italic;
font-weight:300;color:var(–a);margin-top:.8rem;letter-spacing:.05em}
.contra-divider{width:80px;height:1px;background:rgba(196,168,130,.2);margin:1.5rem auto}
.contra-web{font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(250,247,242,.28)}
.contra-social{display:flex;gap:1.2rem;justify-content:center;margin-top:1.2rem}
.contra-social a{font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
color:rgba(250,247,242,.28);text-decoration:none;transition:color .2s}
.contra-social a:hover{color:var(–a)}
.contra-orig{margin-top:2.5rem;font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.18em;
text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(250,247,242,.16)}
.contra-corner{position:absolute;width:24px;height:24px;border-color:rgba(196,168,130,.18);border-style:solid}
.contra-corner.tl{top:16px;left:16px;border-width:1px 0 0 1px}
.contra-corner.tr{top:16px;right:16px;border-width:1px 1px 0 0}
.contra-corner.bl{bottom:16px;left:16px;border-width:0 0 1px 1px}
.contra-corner.br{bottom:16px;right:16px;border-width:0 1px 1px 0}

@media(max-width:700px){
.manif-grid,.lineas-grid,.pgrid,.contacto-grid,.certs-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.ing-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
.nav-links{display:none}
.pc{padding:1.1rem}
.pc-img{width:72px;min-width:72px;height:92px}
}

/* ── HOVER ZOOM on product images ── */
.pc{overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer}
.pc-img{transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);will-change:transform}
.pc:hover .pc-img{transform:scale(1.12)}

/* Subtle glow on hover */
.pc-img-wrap{position:relative;width:88px;min-width:88px;height:112px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:2px;flex-shrink:0}
.pc-img{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.pc-img-wrap::after{content:‘🔍’;position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.7);
color:#fff;font-size:1.1rem;opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s,transform .3s;
text-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.6);pointer-events:none}
.pc:hover .pc-img-wrap::after{opacity:.85;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1)}

/* ── LIGHTBOX overlay ── */
#lightbox{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;background:rgba(26,43,15,.94);
display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:2rem;cursor:zoom-out;
animation:lbfade .25s ease}
#lightbox.active{display:flex}
@keyframes lbfade{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
#lightbox img{max-width:min(90vw,500px);max-height:85vh;object-fit:contain;
border-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 20px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
animation:lbzoom .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
@keyframes lbzoom{from{transform:scale(.85);opacity:0}to{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}
#lightbox .lb-caption{position:absolute;bottom:2rem;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
color:#C4A882;font-family:‘Cormorant Garamond’,serif;font-style:italic;
font-size:1rem;letter-spacing:.04em;text-align:center;pointer-events:none;
text-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
#lightbox .lb-close{position:absolute;top:1.5rem;right:1.5rem;
width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;
background:rgba(196,168,130,.15);border:1px solid rgba(196,168,130,.3);
display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
color:#C4A882;font-size:1.1rem;cursor:pointer;
transition:background .2s,transform .2s}
#lightbox .lb-close:hover{background:rgba(196,168,130,.3);transform:rotate(90deg)}
</style>

</head>
<body>

<nav>
  <div class="nav-logo"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Hampiway"></div>
  <ul class="nav-links">
    <li><a href="#portada">Inicio</a></li>
    <li><a href="#manifiesto">Nosotros</a></li>
    <li><a href="#lineas">Líneas</a></li>
    <li><a href="#agua" class="agu">Agua</a></li>
    <li><a href="#aire" class="air">Aire</a></li>
    <li><a href="#tierra" class="tie">Tierra</a></li>
    <li><a href="#fuego" class="fue">Fuego</a></li>
    <li><a href="#ingredientes">Ingredientes</a></li>
    <li><a href="#certs">Valores</a></li>
    <li><a href="#contacto">Contacto</a></li>
  </ul>
</nav>

<section id="portada" class="pg">
  <div class="portada-corner tl"></div><div class="portada-corner tr"></div>
  <div class="portada-corner bl"></div><div class="portada-corner br"></div>
  <div class="portada-inner">
    <p class="portada-eyebrow">Catálogo Oficial · Edición 2026</p>
    <div class="portada-logo-wrap"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Hampiway"></div>
    <p class="portada-tagline">El camino de la sanación</p>
    <div style="width:100px;height:1px;background:rgba(196,168,130,.18);margin:1.8rem auto"></div>
    <p class="portada-sub">Cosmética Orgánica Andina · Urubamba, Cusco, Perú</p>
  </div>
  <span class="portada-foot l">Urubamba · Valle Sagrado · Perú</span>
  <span class="portada-foot r">Catálogo 2026</span>
</section>

<section id="manifiesto" class="pg">
  <div class="pi-wrap">
    <p class="lbl">Nuestra historia</p><div class="divs"></div>
    <div class="manif-grid">
      <div class="manif-text">
        <h2>Nació de la tierra.<br>Creció con la montaña.</h2>
        <div class="divs"></div>
        <p>Desde el corazón del Valle Sagrado de los Incas, en Urubamba, Cusco, nació <strong>Hampiway</strong> — palabra quechua que significa <em>"el camino de la sanación"</em>. Más de una década de trabajo silencioso, aprendizaje de las tradiciones ancestrales andinas y formulación contemporánea.</p>
        <p>Cada producto es el resultado del diálogo entre la sabiduría de las comunidades quechuas y la rigurosidad de la ingeniería química moderna. Recolectamos con intención, formulamos con conocimiento, entregamos con honestidad.</p>
        <blockquote class="manif-quote">Hampiway no es solo cosmética.<br>Es un ritual de reconexión con los Andes.</blockquote>
        <div class="divh"></div>
        <div class="sellos">
          <span class="sello">🌿 100% Orgánico</span>
          <span class="sello">🐾 Cruelty Free</span>
          <span class="sello">🌍 Origen Andino</span>
          <span class="sello">⚗️ Ing. Química</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="manif-img">Valle Sagrado · Urubamba, Cusco</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="lineas" class="pg">
  <div class="pi-wrap">
    <div class="lineas-header">
      <p class="lbl" style="text-align:center">Nuestras colecciones</p>
      <div class="divs" style="margin:.5rem auto 1rem"></div>

  const lb = document.getElementById('lightbox');
  const img = document.getElementById('lb-img');
  const cap = document.getElementById('lb-cap');
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.pc-img-wrap').forEach(w => {
    w.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      e.preventDefault();
      img.src = w.dataset.src;
      img.alt = w.dataset.name;
      cap.textContent = w.dataset.name;
      lb.classList.add('active');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    });
  });
  
  window.closeLb = function(e){
    if (e && e.target.tagName === 'IMG') return;
    lb.classList.remove('active');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
    setTimeout(() => { img.src = ''; }, 300);
  };
  
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') closeLb();
  });
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>
